input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin object with schema_version toolbox-noaa-sf6-annual-growth-lookup-input-r0 and exactly integer start_year/end_year (1998–2100 inclusive; range at most 50 years)
required_outputs: Provider-reported annual SF6 atmospheric mole-fraction increase and raw-table uncertainty in ppt for each returned year, with explicit FOUND, PARTIAL_DATA, or NO_MATCH status
Fixed NOAA source URL, retrieval timestamp, HTTP status, ETag/Last-Modified when supplied, response SHA-256, and source caveats
